title: Blood Trial
summary: Ha-Jun claims the Ring of Hollow Blood and is pulled into the Blood Trial Mindscape to battle the Shadow of the Sovereign. Subjugating the crimson sea, he unlocks Blood Forging—just as an elite Demon Hunter cuts through the sealed stone doors to execute him.

panels.shot: macro antique silver ring ruby heartbeat
panels.action: Extreme macro on the antique silver Ring of Hollow Blood; its central ruby tear pulses with an internal rhythmic crimson heartbeat glow.
panels.prose_en: Extreme macro on the antique silver Ring of Hollow Blood; its central ruby tear pulses with an internal rhythmic crimson heartbeat glow.
panels.prose_hi: Hollow blood ki prachin chandi ki anguthi par atyadhik macro; iska kendriya ruby aansu ek aantarik laybaddh crimson dil ki dhadkan ki chamak ke saath spandit hota hai.

panels.shot: kuro grave warning perched on altar
panels.action: Kuro perches on the altar rim, voice low: 'Ring of Hollow Blood. Yeh Basic Relic hai, par iski qeemat tazi zindagi ka khoon hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Dhyan se. Yeh relic taze khoon ki qeemat mangti hai.

panels.prose_en: Kuro perches on the altar rim, voice low: 'Ring of Hollow Blood. Yeh Basic Relic hai, par iski qeemat tazi zindagi ka khoon hai.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro vedi ke kinare par baithta hai, awaz dhimi hoti hai: 'khokhle khoon ki anguthi. yeh basic avashesh hai, par iski keemat taji jindagi ka khoon hai.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his bare left hand, index finger hovering a millimeter above the cold silver band with steady resolve.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun extends his bare left hand, index finger hovering a millimeter above the cold silver band with steady resolve.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apna bayan haath badhaya, tarjani sthir sankalp ke saath thande chandi ke band ke upar ek millimeter mandara rahi thi.

panels.action: The instant skin touches silver, multiple razor micro-needles erupt from the inner band, sinking deep into Ha-Jun's ring finger.
panels.prose_en: The instant skin touches silver, multiple razor micro-needles erupt from the inner band, sinking deep into Ha-Jun's ring finger.
panels.prose_hi: Tatkal tvacha chandi ko chhuti hai, aantarik band se kai razor sookshm suiyan nikalti han, jo Ha-Jun ki anamika mein gahrai tak doob jaati han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun winces sharply, teeth bared: 'Agh! Yeh toh ungli ko kaat raha hai!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh ungli mein ghus raha hai...!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun winces sharply, teeth bared: 'Agh! Yeh toh ungli ko kaat raha hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun teji se hilta hai, daant bahar nikalta hai: 'aah! yeh to ungli ko kaat raha hai!'.

panels.action: The central ruby drinks a thread of scarlet blood through the silver filigree, glowing with vivid crimson demonic luminescence.
panels.prose_en: The central ruby drinks a thread of scarlet blood through the silver filigree, glowing with vivid crimson demonic luminescence.
panels.prose_hi: Kendriy manik chandi ke filagri ke madhyam se laal khoon ke ek dhaage ko peeta hai, jo jwalant lal rang ki shaitani demonic chamak ke saath chamakta hai.

panels.action: The silver ring contracts smoothly, resizing itself to fit Ha-Jun's ring finger like an inseparable second skin.
panels.prose_en: The silver ring contracts smoothly, resizing itself to fit Ha-Jun's ring finger like an inseparable second skin.
panels.prose_hi: Chandi ki anguthi sucharu roop se sikudti hai, ek avibhajya dusri tvacha ki tarah Ha-Jun ki anamika mein fit hone ke liye khud ka aakaar badalti hai.

panels.action: A visible shockwave of bright scarlet and deep violet mana explodes up Ha-Jun's left arm, illuminating his arteries through his skin.
panels.prose_en: A visible shockwave of bright scarlet and deep violet mana explodes up Ha-Jun's left arm, illuminating his arteries through his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Chamkile lal rang aur gahre baingani man ki ek drishyaman shockwev Ha-Jun ki bai baanh mein visfot karti hai, jo uski tvacha ke madhyam se uski dhamniyon ko roshan karti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes glaze over; the physical chamber blurs away as his consciousness is ripped into a metaphysical blood dimension.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes glaze over; the physical chamber blurs away as his consciousness is ripped into a metaphysical blood dimension.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen chamak uthin; jaise hi uski chetna ek aadhyatmik khoon aayam mein vibhajit ho jaati hai, bhautik kaksh dhundhla ho jata hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands atop the surface of an endless crimson blood ocean beneath a pitch-black sky without sun or stars.

dialogue.text: Rakt-Sagar... Sovereign ke antarman ki gehrai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands atop the surface of an endless crimson blood ocean beneath a pitch-black sky without sun or stars.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun suraj ya sitaron ke bina gahre kale aakash ke neeche ek antaheen lal rang ke khoon mahasagar ki satah par khada hai.

panels.action: Standing 20 paces away across the blood water is a towering shadow figure clad in full sovereign armor, resembling Ha-Jun's dark twin.

dialogue.text: Uske samne khada tha... uska hi andhera roop.

panels.prose_en: Standing 20 paces away across the blood water is a towering shadow figure clad in full sovereign armor, resembling Ha-Jun's dark twin.
panels.prose_hi: Khun ke pani ke paar 20 kadam ki doori par khadi ek vishal chhaya aakriti purna samprabhu kavach pahane hue hai, jo Ha-Jun ke andhere judwan se milti julti hai.

panels.action: The Shadow speaks with multiple echoing demonic voices: 'Tum ring pehente ho... par kya tum iske malik ho, ya sirf shaitan ka khana?'

dialogue.text: Kya tum malik ho... ya sirf ek kamzor shikar?

panels.prose_en: The Shadow speaks with multiple echoing demonic voices: 'Tum ring pehente ho... par kya tum iske malik ho, ya sirf shaitan ka khana?'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya kai goonjati shaitani demonic aawajon ke saath bolti hai: 'tum ring pahante ho... par kya tum iske malik ho, ya sirf shaitan ka khana?'.

panels.action: The Shadow raises its hand: The crimson ocean erupts as one thousand razor-sharp blood daggers form and float in the air.
panels.prose_en: The Shadow raises its hand: The crimson ocean erupts as one thousand razor-sharp blood daggers form and float in the air.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya apna haath uthati hai: gahre lal rang ka sagar foot padta hai aur ek hajar dhardar khoon khanjar hawa mein tairne lagte han.

panels.action: All one thousand crimson blades aim their needle tips directly at Ha-Jun's neck, hovering inches away from his skin.

dialogue.text: Apna irada saabit karo... warna apne hi khoon mein doob jao.

panels.prose_en: All one thousand crimson blades aim their needle tips directly at Ha-Jun's neck, hovering inches away from his skin.
panels.prose_hi: Sabhi ek hajar lal blade apni sui ki nokon ko sidhe Ha-Jun ki gardan par nishana sadhte han, jo uski tvacha se kuch inch ki doori par hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun's violet eyes blaze with fury: 'Main saat saal tak zaleel hua... taaki aaj apne hi dimaag ke andar maar diya jaaun?!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN KISI KE AAGE NAHI JHUKUNGA!!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's violet eyes blaze with fury: 'Main saat saal tak zaleel hua... taaki aaj apne hi dimaag ke andar maar diya jaaun?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki baingani aankhen gusse se chamak uthin: 'main saat saal tak jaleel hua... taki aaj apne hi dimag ke andar maar diya jaun?!'

panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward and stomps his boot hard onto the surface of the blood sea, releasing a royal purple shockwave.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun steps forward and stomps his boot hard onto the surface of the blood sea, releasing a royal purple shockwave.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai aur apne jute ko khoon ke samudra ki satah par jor se patakta hai, jisse ek shahi baingani shockwev nikalti hai.

panels.action: The purple shockwave sweeps across the blades; all one thousand blood daggers instantly freeze motionless under Ha-Jun's absolute command.
panels.prose_en: The purple shockwave sweeps across the blades; all one thousand blood daggers instantly freeze motionless under Ha-Jun's absolute command.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni shockwev bledon par ghumti hai; Ha-Jun ke purna aadesh ke tahat sabhi ek hajar khoon khanjar turant gatiheen ho jaate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun sweeps his right arm horizontally: All one thousand blood blades whip around 180 degrees, pointing directly at the Shadow!
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sweeps his right arm horizontally: All one thousand blood blades whip around 180 degrees, pointing directly at the Shadow!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne dahine haath ko kshaitij roop se ghumata hai: sabhi ek hajar khoon blade 180 degree ke aaspaas ghumte han, jo sidhe chhaya ki or ishara karte han!

panels.action: The Shadow reflection smiles with dark, ancient royal approval: 'Shabash... yahi hai Sovereign ka saccha ghamand.'

dialogue.text: Shabash. Tum wakai is takht ke kaabil ho.

panels.prose_en: The Shadow reflection smiles with dark, ancient royal approval: 'Shabash... yahi hai Sovereign ka saccha ghamand.'.
panels.prose_hi: Chhaya chhaya gahre, prachin shahi anumodan ke saath muskurata hai: 'shabash... yahi hai Sovereign ka sachcha ghamand.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun clenches his fist: The thousand blades converge in a crimson whirlwind, fusing into a colossal 30-foot Blood Halberd.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun clenches his fist: The thousand blades converge in a crimson whirlwind, fusing into a colossal 30-foot Blood Halberd.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni mutthi band kar li: hajaron blade ek lal rang ke bavandar mein parivartit ho gaye, ek vishal 30-fut khoon helbard mein mil gaye.

panels.action: Ha-Jun thrusts the massive blood halberd straight through the Shadow's armored chest in a blinding explosion of scarlet mist.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun thrusts the massive blood halberd straight through the Shadow's armored chest in a blinding explosion of scarlet mist.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun scarlet dhundh ke ek chakachaundh visfot mein bade paimane par khoon ko sidhe chhaya ki bakhtarband chhati ke madhyam se fenkata hai.

panels.action: The entire blood dimension fractures into a million geometric glass shards, dissolving into brilliant white light.
panels.prose_en: The entire blood dimension fractures into a million geometric glass shards, dissolving into brilliant white light.
panels.prose_hi: Sampurn khoon aayam lakhon jyamitiya kaanch ke tukdon mein toot jata hai aur chamakdar safed roshni mein ghul jata hai.

panels.action: Snap back: Ha-Jun blinks back into physical reality, chest heaving and sweat dripping from his chin onto the stone altar.
panels.prose_en: Snap back: Ha-Jun blinks back into physical reality, chest heaving and sweat dripping from his chin onto the stone altar.
panels.prose_hi: Snap back: Ha-Jun bhautik vastavikta mein wapas jhapkata hai, uski chhati phool rahi hai aur uski thuddi se patthar ki vedi par pasina tapak raha hai.

panels.action: A royal amethyst system screen chimes: [BLOOD TRIAL PASSED] | [RELIC 2/10: RING OF HOLLOW BLOOD BOUND] | [SKILL: BLOOD FORGING (RANK E)].
panels.prose_en: A royal amethyst system screen chimes: [BLOOD TRIAL PASSED] | [RELIC 2/10: RING OF HOLLOW BLOOD BOUND] | [SKILL: BLOOD FORGING (RANK E)].
panels.prose_hi: Ek shahi neelam pranali screen ki jhankar: [khoon parikshan uttirn] | [avshesh 2/10: khokhale khoon se bandhi anguthi] | [kaushal: khoon nirman (rank e)].

panels.shot: blood forging dagger in hand macro
panels.action: Ha-Jun tests his new skill: A droplet of blood from his palm elongates and solidifies into a razor-sharp, crystalline red dagger in his grip.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tests his new skill: A droplet of blood from his palm elongates and solidifies into a razor-sharp, crystalline red dagger in his grip.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne naye kaushal ka parikshan karta hai: uski hatheli se khoon ki ek boond badhti hai aur uski pakad mein ek tej, crystaliy lal khanjar mein jam jaati hai.

panels.action: Kuro flaps his dark wings with delight: 'Khoon se hathiyar banane ki taqat! Yeh blade kabhi kharab nahi hogi!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Kamaal! Khoon se banna hathiyar kabhi nahi tootega!

panels.prose_en: Kuro flaps his dark wings with delight: 'Khoon se hathiyar banane ki taqat! Yeh blade kabhi kharab nahi hogi!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro khushi se apne kale pankh fadfadata hai: 'khun se hathiyar banane ki taakat! yeh blade kabhi kharab nahin hogi!'.

panels.action: Suddenly, the 10-ton sealed stone slab at the chamber entrance shakes under heavy concussive strikes from the outside: *THUD!! THUD!!*
panels.prose_en: Suddenly, the 10-ton sealed stone slab at the chamber entrance shakes under heavy concussive strikes from the outside: *THUD!! THUD!!*.
panels.prose_hi: Achanak, kaksh ke pravesh dwar par 10 ton ka silband patthar ka slab bahar se aane wale bhari aaghat ke karan hill jata hai: *thood!! gadgdahat!!*.

panels.action: A high-frequency blade of glowing silver mana cuts through the solid 3-foot thick stone slab like a hot knife through butter.
panels.prose_en: A high-frequency blade of glowing silver mana cuts through the solid 3-foot thick stone slab like a hot knife through butter.
panels.prose_hi: Chamkati chandi man ka ek uchch aavritti wala blade thos 3 foot mote patthar ke slab ko makkhan ke madhyam se garm chaku ki tarah kaatata hai.

panels.action: Kuro's feathers bristle in genuine alarm: 'Silver mana... YEH HUMAN DEMON HUNTER HAI! Wo basement tak pahunch gaye!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Silver mana... Demon Hunter aa gaya hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro's feathers bristle in genuine alarm: 'Silver mana... YEH HUMAN DEMON HUNTER HAI! Wo basement tak pahunch gaye!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ke pankh vastavik chinta se fadak uthe: 'rajat man... yeh manav danav shikari hai! woh basement tak pahunch gaye!'.

panels.shot: hunter in white coat entrance cliffhanger
panels.action: The stone slab explodes inward; stepping through the dust cloud is an elite Hunter in a white tactical coat wielding twin silver blades: 'Target confirmed. Shaitan ka waris, Kang Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: hunter_captain
dialogue.text: Target confirmed. Shaitan ka waris, Kang Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: The stone slab explodes inward; stepping through the dust cloud is an elite Hunter in a white tactical coat wielding twin silver blades: 'Target confirmed. Shaitan ka waris, Kang Ha-Jun.'.
panels.prose_hi: Patthar ki patiya andar ki or fat jaati hai; dhul ke badal ke beech se gujarte hue ek vishisht shikari safed samrik coat mein do chandi ke blade lahrate hue aage badh raha hai: 'lakshya ki pushti ho gai hai. shaitan ka varis, kang Ha-Jun.'
